newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivia could be Mercosur-Andean Pact link - Menem.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia could be Mercosur-Andean Pact link - Menem.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem said Tuesday that Bolivia could serve as a bridge between the Mercosur customs union and the Andean Pact trade bloc.
"Obviously, Bolivia could convert itself into a link in the not-too-distant future between Mercosur and the Andean Pact," the visiting Argentine president told a business group.

Bolivia is expected to sign a free trade deal with Mercosur, a customs union comprising Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay and Paraguay, in January. Chile signed a similar deal with Mercosur earlier this year.
Members of the Andean Pact, Bolivia, Venezuela, Ecuador, Colombia and Peru, have expressed interest in a free trade accord with Mercosur.
Bolivia borders three of the Mercosur countries, Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay.
